description: スマートフォン向け太線・人物拡大版

prompts.situation: Use case: style-transfer. Edit this educational illustration for a SMALL PHONE thumbnail, about 280px wide. Make ALL outlines much thicker, bold dark navy uniform 12-16px strokes at 1536px canvas width, with rounded joins. Cable must also be bold and legible, but remain far narrower than the broad solid gray concrete utility pole. Enlarge the blue-shirt yellow-backpack person to about 50 percent of image height. Reduce empty sky drastically; tighter composition with person on left, dangling cable in middle and pole on right, preserving a clearly visible separation between person and wire. Full person, dangling cable end, attachment insulator and pole base all visible with small margins. Keep person standing still looking toward wire; preserve scene meaning. Extremely simple flat solid fills, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, remove grass detail and unnecessary road edging. Pale blue background, gray street with side path toward bottom left. No text, arrows, symbols, sparks or extra people. One landscape 3:2 image.
prompts.distance: Edit reference into another choice illustration. Preserve EXACTLY its very thick bold navy outlines, large objects, tight 3:2 framing, simple palette, pole and dangling wire geometry. Change ONLY person pose: same large blue-shirt yellow-backpack person at far left WALKING LEFT away from cable toward side path, one hand raised to warn people off frame. Whole person visible and as large as reference. Large clear gap from cable. No extra people, text, arrows or symbols. Keep extremely simple for 280px wide phone thumbnail. ONE image.
prompts.go: Edit reference into a choice illustration. Preserve its very thick bold navy outlines, large objects, simple colors, framing, utility pole and dangling cable. Change ONLY person position and pose: same blue-shirt yellow-backpack person crouching deeply beneath the elevated middle-right part of cable, left of pole, trying to pass underneath. Large readable bent-knee pose, about 45 percent image height while crouched. Cable must pass visibly ABOVE bowed head/back with a small clear air gap, never overlap person or touch body. Free severed end still visible left of person. Hypothetical risky option, no approval cues. No text, arrows, sparks or extra people. 3:2 single image readable at 280px width.
prompts.consider: Edit reference into another choice illustration. Preserve EXACTLY its very thick bold navy outlines, large objects, tight 3:2 framing, simple palette, pole and dangling wire geometry. Change ONLY person pose and position: same LARGE blue-shirt yellow-backpack person standing center-left, holding a small dark phone at ear and waiting, looking toward wire. Keep person full height as in reference, about 60 percent of canvas height, and a clear air gap between person and dangling cable end. No contact. No extra people, text, arrows or symbols. Keep extremely simple for 280px wide phone thumbnail. ONE image.
